headline: Bank of Jamaica Announces US Dollar Sale Operation
summary: The Bank of Jamaica has initiated a standard sale operation for US dollars to be conducted via the JamClear-CSD system.
why: Central bank interventions in the foreign exchange market are used to manage liquidity and stabilize the local currency against the US dollar, directly impacting exchange rates and monetary policy transmission.

impacts.name: Jamaican Dollar
impacts.why: Selling US dollars increases the supply of foreign currency, typically supporting the local currency's value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Central bank FX interventions directly alter the supply-demand balance of the local currency, typically aimed at curbing volatility or supporting the exchange rate.
